AcceptedBody.description: 202 Accepted body for a large trace. Served at HTTP 200 by the live handler (the two shapes share the success status; see SPEC T-35 Wave 1).
AcceptedBody.title: AcceptedBody

audit_event_ids.description: Audit event ids covering this signature (row-change + `esign_id` link).

record_content_hash.description: SHA-256 of that snapshot. On the wire this is a JSON array of 32 integers, not the hex string on [`SignatureManifest::record_content_hash`].

record_snapshot.description: Canonical snapshot that was hashed. Any JSON value.

seals.description: Seals covering those events (`prev_hash` chain from `audit.tx_seal`).

blob_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the archived blob.

AuditExportBody.description:
GET `/api/v1/audit` body.

Not [`wicket_audit::Head`]: the wire omits `hash` and `sealed_at`. Inner keys match the `json!` blob (alphabetical). `head` is always present (`null` when the chain has no seal). A derived `Option` omits the key from `required`; [`audit_head_schema`] keeps the key required and the value nullable.
AuditExportBody.title: AuditExportBody

CalibrationApprovedBody.description:
POST `/api/v1/calibration/certificates/{id}/approve` success body.

The engine emits `{ id, status: "approved" }`. `status` is that literal, not an open string of future states.
CalibrationApprovedBody.title: CalibrationApprovedBody

signing_session_expires_at.description: When the current signing session expires, if any.

ControlledDocumentBody.description: Document response for create, get, submit, and approve. `version` is the state-machine instance version.
ControlledDocumentBody.title: ControlledDocumentBody

CurrencyId.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency code; the catalog row lives in the database.

DefineBody.description:
POST `/api/v1/customfields/definitions` body.

`type` is [`FieldType::as_str`] (`"string"`). `id`, when present, is rejected.
DefineBody.title: DefineBody

indexed.description: Indexed hint (per-type btree exists on PK).

DefinitionId.description:
Stable definition identity (all versions share this id).

Serde is the inner uuid string (newtype). The derived schema is that string with `format: uuid`.

DefinitionStatus.description:
Definition lifecycle.

Serde emits the variant name (`"Active"` / `"Retired"`), not [`Self::as_str`]. The retire HTTP blob sends the `as_str` token `"retired"`.

DimensionKind.description: The sealed kernel dimension set. Adding a variant is a kernel change and a migration, never a customization. Modules cannot extend it.

oneOf.description: Duration. Labor-hours may or may not live here; `TimeDim` exists either way.
Both directions from the same start.

DocumentCreate.description: POST `/api/v1/documents` body. `id` is rejected with 400 if present.
DocumentCreate.title: DocumentCreate

EmptyBody.description: Empty JSON object accepted on deactivate (empty bytes also accepted).
EmptyBody.title: EmptyBody

ExpiryPrecision.description: Expiry precision. A bare `DATE` is forbidden (invariant 12).

oneOf.description: Calendar month; stored as the first of that month.

ExpiryWire.description: Wire expiry `{value, precision}` (`docs/10` §3.4). Month/year omit an invented day.

value.description: Value formatted to the claimed precision (`YYYY-MM-DD` / `YYYY-MM` / `YYYY`).

FieldType.description:
Stored field type (no JSON blob).

Serde emits the variant name (`"String"`), not [`Self::as_str`] (`"string"`). List-definition JSON uses this enum; request bodies and [`ValueWire::type_name`] use the `as_str` token.

FinishedLotRef.description: Nested `finished_lot` object on the complete response blob.

Impact.description: Recall list: forward closure to CUSTOMER boundary postings (D2 case g).

customers.description: Customer / sales-order references on those documents.

shipments.description: Inventory shipment documents that reached CUSTOMER.

Impact.title: Impact

residual_tolerance.description: Residual tolerance as a decimal string.

oneOf.description: Exhausted retries or fatal handler error.

JobStatus.description: Snapshot of a job row for readers.
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

LineBody.description: Wire document line. Lots and serials are entity ids, never text.

next_cursor.description: Opaque next cursor (`id` of the last row on this page).
Opaque next cursor (`id` of the last row on this page).

boundary_class.description: Virtual boundary class when `kind == Virtual`. Serde is PascalCase variant name or null; `Boundary` has no `JsonSchema`.

parent_id.description: Parent in the tree (`None` for roots).

LocationKind.description: Structural kind of a location node.

LocationStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a location row.

oneOf.description: Hidden from pick lists; cannot receive new stock.

LocationSummary.description:
Wire body for `createLocation` and `getLocation`.

Five fields only. `listLocations` and `deactivateLocation` serialize the full [`Location`] row instead.
LocationSummary.title: LocationSummary

children.description: Children in sort order by code.

LotStatus.description: Lot / serial status. Inventory posts the corresponding movement; this module records the status and its history only.

ManifestModuleBody.description: Wire shape of one interpolated `ManifestModule` (keys sorted by `json!`).

NoContentJson.description: Idempotency replay shape and OpenAPI stand-in for HTTP 204 success (no response body).
NoContentJson.title: NoContentJson

OnHandBody.description: GET `/api/v1/inventory/on-hand` body. Amounts are decimal strings, not `AnyQuantity`.
OnHandBody.title: OnHandBody

OpenApiDocument.description:
GET `/api/v1/openapi.json` — the OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (self-describing JSON object).

Schema-only: the handler still returns `Json<Value>` of [`crate::openapi::document`].
OpenApiDocument.title: OpenApiDocument

PackageCreate.description: POST `/api/v1/lots/{id}/packages` body. `contained` is the AnyQuantity wire (`docs/10` §3.1); the handler stores it as [`QuantityBody`] so amount stays a decimal string. `label_ref` is accepted and stored, not echoed.
PackageCreate.title: PackageCreate

PackageCreatedBody.description: POST `/api/v1/lots/{id}/packages` 201 body. Frozen from the handler `json!` blob: field is `contained`, not `PackageBody.contained_quantity`; `label_ref` is omitted even when the request supplied one.
PackageCreatedBody.title: PackageCreatedBody

PackageListItem.description: GET `/api/v1/lots/{id}/packages` item. Frozen from the handler `json!` blob: omits `lot_id` and `label_ref`.
PackageListItem.title: PackageListItem

PrincipalBody.description: GET `/api/v1/identity/me` (and principal read) body. Timestamps stay RFC 3339 strings at seconds precision, matching the previous `json!` emission.
PrincipalBody.title: PrincipalBody

QuantityBody.description: Wire quantity (`docs/10`: amount is a decimal string).

RecordBody.description: Record locator shared by print render and archive request bodies.
RecordBody.title: RecordBody

RenderPrintResponse.description:
POST `/api/v1/print/render` success body.

This is the archival blob the handler emits today, not [`wicket_print::Rendered`]. `output_hash` and `blob` hashes elsewhere are lowercase hex. `bytes_base64` is the rendition bytes. `manifestation` is [`Manifestation`] as `wicket-esign` serializes it. That type lives in a sibling crate, so its schema is hand-specified here rather than derived on a copy.

manifestation.description: Esign snapshots for the record. Empty when none exist.

output_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the rendition bytes.

renderer_version.description: Crate version that produced the bytes.

RenderPrintResponse.title: RenderPrintResponse

RetireResponse.description:
POST `/api/v1/customfields/definitions/{id}/retire` body.

`status` is [`DefinitionStatus::as_str`] (`"retired"`), not the enum serde name `"Retired"`.
RetireResponse.title: RetireResponse

ReverseIssueBody.description: POST `/api/v1/inventory/reversals` response: a document plus reversal fields.
ReverseIssueBody.title: ReverseIssueBody

RevisionCreate.description: POST `/api/v1/documents/{id}/revisions` body. `id` is rejected with 400 if present. Omitted or null `content` is stored as `{}`.
RevisionCreate.title: RevisionCreate

SealRef.description: One seal in an archival bundle.

hash.description: Seal hash bytes. The audit export stores hex; the bundle decodes it and serde emits a JSON array of integers.

prev_hash.description: Previous seal hash, same encoding as [`Self::hash`]. JSON null when absent.

SignatureEdgeBody.description: Wire shape of interpolated [`SignatureEdge`] (externally tagged; inner keys sorted).

superseded.description: True when the live `sm.instance.version` is greater than `record.version`.

TemplateSummary.description: Latest effective template row (list seam; no body).

body_hash.description: SHA-256 of the template body, lowercase hex.

semantic_version.description: Semantic version stamped on that row.

version.description: Integer version of the latest effective row.

TemplateSummary.title: TemplateSummary

Tree.description: A forest returned by a single-direction trace.

TreeNode.description: One node of the genealogy tree the mockup draws.

amount.description: Edge amount into this node (wire shape of [`wicket_core::Money`]). `serde(with = rust_decimal::serde::str)` so the wire is a string; a bare derive would not compile and a numeric schema would disagree with the wire.

item.description: Item on the lot, when the posting carries a lot.

location.description: Location, when known from a published inventory document.

UnitId.description: Opaque catalog identifier. Core never interprets the catalog.

ValidationManifestBody.description:
GET `/api/v1/iq/manifest` body.

This is the live `json!` blob, not [`wicket_module::ConfigurationManifest`]: the handler omits `app_version`. Field order is alphabetical so `Json(self)` matches `serde_json::json!` (`Map` is `BTreeMap` without `preserve_order`).
ValidationManifestBody.title: ValidationManifestBody

ValueWire.description:
Wire shape for a stored value (`docs/10`).

[`Self::type_name`] is [`FieldType::as_str`] (`"string"`), not the enum's serde name (`"String"`). [`Self::value`] is the handler `value_payload` JSON, not [`Value`]'s externally tagged serde.

value.description: Payload for [`Self::type_name`], or null when the definition is unset.

ValueWire.title: ValueWire

WorkOrderIssueLine.description: Schema-only mirror of `ReceiptLine` (lives in `handlers/mod.rs`, not owned here).

info.description: Wave 2s slice. The UI consumes this document (ADR 0009).
info.title: Wicket HTTP API
